grid.expression: SELECT DISTINCT V.CODNAT, (SELECT DISTINCT N.DESCRNAT FROM TGFNAT N WHERE N.CODNAT = V.CODNAT) AS DESCRNAT, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 01 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS JAN, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 02 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS FEV, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 03 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS MAR, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 04 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS ABR, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 05 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS MAI, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 06 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS JUN, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 07 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS JUL, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 08 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS AGO, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 09 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS SETE, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 10 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS OUTU, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 11 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS NOV, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN (CASE WHEN V.MES = 12 THEN V.VLRBAIXA END) END)) AS DEZ, SUM((CASE WHEN V.ANO = :P_ANO THEN V.VLRBAIXA END)) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT FIN.CODNAT, SUM(FIN.VLRBAIXA) AS VLRBAIXA, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FIN.DHBAIXA) AS MES, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FIN.DHBAIXA) AS ANO FROM TGFFIN FIN WHERE FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR FIN.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) AND (:P_ANO IS NULL OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FIN.DHBAIXA) = :P_ANO) AND NVL(FIN.NUFIN,0) NOT IN (SELECT R.NUFIN FROM TGFRAT R WHERE R.ORIGEM = 'F') AND NVL(FIN.NUNOTA,0) NOT IN (SELECT R.NUFIN FROM TGFRAT R WHERE R.ORIGEM = 'E') GROUP BY FIN.CODNAT, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FIN.DHBAIXA), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FIN.DHBAIXA) UNION ALL SELECT TB1.CODNAT, SUM(TB1.VLRBAIXA) AS VLRBAIXA, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TB1.DHBAIXA) AS MES, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TB1.DHBAIXA) AS ANO FROM (SELECT RAT.ORIGEM, RAT.NUFIN, RAT.CODNAT, ROUND(((RAT.PERCRATEIO/100) * FIN.VLRBAIXA),2) AS VLRBAIXA, FIN.DHBAIXA FROM TGFRAT RAT INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON (RAT.NUFIN = FIN.NUFIN AND RAT.ORIGEM = 'F') WHERE FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR RAT.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) AND (:P_ANO IS NULL OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FIN.DHBAIXA) = :P_ANO) UNION ALL SELECT RAT.ORIGEM, RAT.NUFIN, RAT.CODNAT, ROUND(((RAT.PERCRATEIO/100) * FIN.VLRBAIXA),2) AS VLRBAIXA , FIN.DHBAIXA FROM TGFRAT RAT INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON (RAT.NUFIN = FIN.NUNOTA AND RAT.ORIGEM = 'E') WHERE FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR RAT.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) AND (:P_ANO IS NULL OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FIN.DHBAIXA) = :P_ANO)) TB1 GROUP BY TB1.CODNAT, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TB1.DHBAIXA), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TB1.DHBAIXA)) ORDER BY CODNAT, MES, ANO) V WHERE V.VLRBAIXA > 0 AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR V.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) GROUP BY V.CODNAT ORDER BY V.CODNAT
